label: Майчинство: държавата предлага 450 евро, протестиращите искат 70% от осигурителния доход
text: The bill raises the benefit for raising a child up to age two from €398.81 to €450 from 1 Jan 2027 — the first increase since 2023 — and lifts the benefit for mothers who do not take the pregnancy/childrearing leave from 50% to 75%. The „Родители за достойно майчинство“ initiative and „Достойнство 2023“ protested outside Parliament on that demand (70% of the mother's gross insured income, plus 100% of the NOI benefit on early return to work), arguing for income-linked rather than flat amounts. Elsewhere in the social package: 9 of 12 family benefits up for €72.5m, the poverty line set at €443 for 2027 costing €114.3m, and the minimum daily unemployment benefit rising from €9.21 to €13.
